channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marcus Camby | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marcus Camby from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Kaplan on Marcus Camby
item.description:
Mark Berman:Agent Rick Kaplan on Marcus Camby joining the Rockets:

“Marcus is extremely excited 2 b coming back 2 the Rockets. He believes he can add veteran leadership to a potent young core that can compete 4 the NBA title.”

Rick Kaplan on Marcus Camby, Jul 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Rick Kaplan on Marcus Camby
item.description:
The Toronto Raptors, who acquired Camby in a trade with the New York Knicks last week, bought out the remaining $7.5 million on his contract and placed him on waivers on Friday.

“If Marcus becomes a free agent as we expect on Sunday the Rockets are a leading contender for where he'll end up next season,”

Rick Kaplan on Marcus Camby, Jul 20, 2013. Source: FOX 26 Sports.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Marcus Camby
item.description:
Camby has been sidelined for the entire preseason and for the Knicks' first three regular season games with a left calf strain.

“I can't give you the minutes (Camby will play against Dallas), but he'll play tomorrow, absolutely,”

Mike Woodson on Marcus Camby, Nov 8, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jason Kidd, Jeremy Lin, Marcus Camby
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony on the Knicks' offseason moves:

“I think bringing Jason Kidd and Marcus Camby will definitely help us in our journey to get to a championship. Hopefully we can re-sign Jeremy Lin. We're making great strides and it's just a matter of us coming together and willing to do what it takes to win.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jason Kidd, Jeremy Lin, Marcus Camby, Jul 15, 2012. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Marcus Camby
item.description:
Nate Taylor:More Carmelo on Camby:

“He’s been in NY & to have him back, & for him to still be able to do what he can do, I want that.”

Carmelo Anthony on Marcus Camby, Jul 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Marcus Camby
item.description:
Tyson Chandler did a double take when I asked:

“Do you think the center tandem of you backing up Camby will work.”

Tyson Chandler on Marcus Camby, Jul 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Marcus Camby
item.description:
However, Blazers coach Nate McMillan said a bigger factor has been the absence of center Marcus Camby, who has been out the last five games after having knee surgery.

“Part of what is happening to L.A. is Camby was good with him, and we don’t have Camby,”

Nate McMillan on Marcus Camby, Jan 30, 2011. Source: Oregonian.
